# COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS

## Town of Sutton

**Pursuant to GL Chapter 30A, §§ 18-25 you are hereby notified of a meeting which includes this agenda**

- **Board/Committee:** Planning Board
- **Date:** November 16, 2026
- **Time:** 7:00 P.M.
- **Location:** This meeting will be held in person at Town Hall and virtually by using the online Zoom application at https://zoom.us/join or via phone at 1-929-205-6099 US (New York) using

**Meeting ID:** 871 9375 4900

**Passcode:** 631975

7 PM - Board Discussion about the process of drafting data center bylaws and initial discussion on the format of community engagement

NOTE - Meeting materials can be viewed on the Town's website at https://www.suttonma.org on the Planning Board page or can be requested via email to j.hager@town.sutton.ma.us or by phone to 508-865-8729.
